description_nl: group_name_max / group_description_max / request_reason_max: characters kept. requests_kept: access requests remembered (oldest drop off). requests_shown: requests the People & access page lists. new_screens_to_catch_all (2026-10-19): when the portal gains a non-admin screen, add an Allow for it to Catch All once - the screen is remembered in the access file's seen_screens, so removing it from Catch All later sticks; off = a new screen is closed until the owner allows it somewhere. A draft (Menu builder) is remembered as it arrives, so putting it live later never adds it (2026-10-26 owner). new_group_inherits_catch_all: the parent a new group starts with (on = Catch All, off = none).
